prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1091; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the scene, the responding officer observed two passenger vehicles in a head-on configuration in the northbound lanes of a Houston, Texas roadway. Driver 1 was seated in the operator's position of the first vehicle and stated that the other vehicle crossed into the lane at low speed. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle was traveling slowly and attempted to steer away before contact. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage consistent with a low-speed impact. A Passenger in the second vehicle reported minor discomfort and declined medical transport. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported by EMS for evaluation. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of the statements obtained from all parties involved.
